reason: The cited evidence (E1) shows that Al+Ti additions to FCC HEAs form γ′ precipitates with good high-temperature stability, but it describes a Ni-Co-Fe-Cr-Al-Ti system, not a Ti–Ni primary HEA. The hypothesis extrapolates this mechanism to a different base composition without direct evidence that a Ti–Ni primary alloy will form a disordered γ matrix or that Al alone (without Co, Fe, Cr) will produce the same γ′ phase. E2 discusses additive manufacturing and is irrelevant to the precipitation mechanism.
